newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 3.12 million barrels in the week ended Feb 14 to 304.88 million barrels from a revised 301.76 million barrels that was previously reported as 299.47 million the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Wednesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 7.14 million barrels in the week to 242.08 million barrels.
Distillate stocks fell 2.90 million barrels to 107.71 million from 110.61 million the previous week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 2.11 million barrels to 39.31 million barrels.
API said gasoline production rose 244,000 barrels in the week to 7.29 million bpd from 7.04 million.
Gasoline stocks fell 1.27 million barrels in the week to 206.29 million barrels from 207.56 million barrels.
Percent of stocks capacity rose to 88.3 percent from 87.6 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 849,000 barrels to 39.44 million barrels from 38.59 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 13.39 million barrels from 13.24 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 42.62 million barrels from 43.36 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports fell to 7.43 million barrels per day from 7.89 million, API said.
